description: Amendments to planning permission dated 23rd May 2024 (RN 24/00479/FULL) for the Variation of condition 1 of planning permission dated 8th August 2017 (RN:16/12291/FULL) which in itself was for the Variation of Condition 1 of planning permission dated 2 April 2015 (RN: 14/08070/FULL) for Demolition of existing Barracks buildings (except for the listed Riding School) and redevelopment for residential use (Class C3) to provide a total of 171 units including 59 affordable units . Use of the listed Riding School as private ancillary leisure facility with internal and external alterations. Provision of Class A1/A3 retail units and Class D1  at ground level at 1 - 7 Queen's Terrace, redevelopment behind the retained front facade and the erection of a mansard roof extension ,creation of landscaped areas and reconfigured vehicular and pedestrian access together with associated works including the provision of parking, circulation space, servicing and plant area and use of the listed Riding School as a private ancillary leisure facility, associated internal and external alterations, new side extension and  the excavation of a lower ground floor beneath the Riding School. NAMELY,to amend  a 300mm increase in height of the approved roof terrace enclosure on three sides of the terrace; Photovoltaic panels are proposed on Block 7 and 8; The internal arrangements of the residential unit at the top of Block 3 have been reconfigured to a new internal room has been created by infilling the recessed external terrace along the south façade; inset external terrace on the eastern elevation has been reconfigured and infilled to align with the principal façade line to block 6; The Block 3 entrance lobby has been updated to open the space up and provide better visual connection from the entrance through to the reception area;  proposed to the mansard dormer cladding of Block 9a dormers from zinc to aluminium due to material compatibility; and kitchen flue cladding to the rear of Block 9.
